title: Reset Dependence Is Embodied: Training Protocol Changes Which Morphologies Appear Optimal
abstract: arXiv:2611.29518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot co-design benchmarks rank bodies after training their controllers under a fixed episode protocol, but that protocol can change the ranking itself. Consequently, two studies can select different bodies from the same corpus even when they use the same task and evaluator. We study one part of that protocol, the reset rule, which ends a training episode when the robot's torso falls below a height threshold. We train proximal policy optimization (PPO) controllers for 100 DERL-evolved UNIMAL bodies with this threshold at 20% of each body's starting torso height (Standard), at 50% (Strict), or with no threshold (Reset-free), and score every controller with the same evaluator. The threshold changes which bodies look best: the rankings after Strict and Reset-free training correlate at only 0.21, against about 0.89 if seed noise were the only difference. translated_title: 重置依赖是具身的：训练协议会改变哪些形态看起来最优
translated_abstract: 机器人协同设计基准在固定回合协议下训练控制器后对机体形态进行排名，但该协议本身可能会改变排名结果。因此，即使两项研究使用相同的任务和评估器，也可能从同一机体库中选出不同的机体。我们研究了该协议的一部分——重置规则，即当机器人躯干低于某个高度阈值时结束训练回合。我们为100个由DERL演化出的UNIMAL机体训练近端策略优化（PPO）控制器，阈值分别设为每个机体起始躯干高度的20%（标准）、50%（严格）或不设阈值（无重置），并使用相同的评估器对所有控制器进行评分。阈值会改变哪些机体看起来最优：严格训练与无重置训练后的排名相关性仅为0.21，而如果种子噪声是唯一差异来源，相关性约为0.89。移除跌倒重置对某些机体的性能代价远高于其他机体。在平坦地面上演化出的机体……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现机器人协同设计基准中的训练协议重置规则会显著改变形态排名——严格训练与无重置训练的排名相关性仅0.21——因此同一机体库在不同协议下可能选出截然不同的最优形态。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the reset rule in a robot co-design benchmark's training protocol significantly alters morphology rankings—with Strict and Reset-free training rankings correlating at only 0.21—so the same body corpus can yield entirely different optimal morphologies under different protocols.
